What is my health insurance number?

response.text:
Ordnung doesn't have a health insurance number stored for you personally — your own records only include a tax ID, tax number, social insurance number, student number and broadcasting fee number [item:n1][item:n2][item:n3][item:n4][item:n5] (not actual item ids, see below).

More precisely:

- No health insurance number is on file under your own name.
- There is a health insurance number (Versicherten-Nr.) on file, but it's filed for your household member Alex Rivera, from a letter by Muster BKK [party:pty_eatxsexnt9s3] [doc:doc_9t9tmrv1ypba] — this is Alex's number, not yours, so I won't give it as your own.

If you have a health insurance letter of your own, you could file it in Ordnung and I can then pull the number from it.
